summary: The exact candidate fixes the narrower missing DiffGenerator lifecycle client API and malformed-response AttributeError leak, but it does not verify or complete the original diffusion sleep/wake feature contract. Real diffusion generation/refit behavior and the requested timing comparison remain untested, and FSDP inference remains unsupported.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent malformed-response, broker-shaped response, explicit FSDP-unsupported, and MI350X controller numerical round-trip cases. The GPU output matched an independent CPU reference with max absolute error 7.152557373046875e-07.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015. The independent GPU test validates the pre-existing MemoryOccupationController only; it does not validate the candidate DiffGenerator transport, a real diffusion architecture, disk refit, or distributed behavior.
native_rebuild_evidence: Not applicable: candidate changes only Python, tests, documentation, and reports; no C++, HIP, FlyDSL, or other native source changed.
remaining_counterexamples: No real diffusion checkpoint was run through generation, sleep, wake, post-wake generation, and disk refit, so model-specific correctness and memory behavior remain unverified.
No end-to-end sleep+wake+refit versus kill-and-relaunch timing comparison was supplied or independently possible, despite being an explicit original-issue objective.
FSDP inference sleep/wake remains explicitly unsupported and independently raises RuntimeError: sleep/wake does not support FSDP inference.

The candidate's regression mocks sync_scheduler_client.forward; its GPU case exercises MemoryOccupationController code already present in the base, so the new DiffGenerator transport surface was not exercised end to end on GPU.
A broker-shaped plain dictionary error reply is converted to a lifecycle RuntimeError but loses the broker's original message and reports only that no status payload was returned.
remaining_limitations: No qualifying diffusion model weights were present in the prepared private runtime.
The supplied tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify diffusion architecture, semantic output, memory behavior, disk refit, or timing and therefore was not used as substitute evidence.
Distributed diffusion and CUDA/NVIDIA behavior were not tested; the available architecture was a single AMD Instinct MI350X under ROCm 7.2.
No native rebuild was applicable because no native source changed.
